titleEn: Archaeological finds at an Irish fort reveal insights into the finer side of medieval life
titleZh: 爱尔兰古堡的考古发现，揭示中世纪生活精致的一面
method: Machine reference translation with paragraph alignment; not manually certified.

paragraphs.en:
Popular media, from computer games to movies, often portrays medieval life as being
dominated by fighters and farmers. In these depictions, there’s little evidence of a world beyond political struggle and simple subsistence.
paragraphs.zh:
从电脑游戏到电影，大众媒体经常把中世纪的生活描绘成
在这些地区，几乎没有证据表明，除了政治斗争和简单的生存之外，还有一个世界。

paragraphs.en: Leisure activities are often overlooked, despite the fact that they existed in one form or another at most – if not all – levels of medieval society. The intangible nature of much of the evidence, often coupled with poor preservation of physical objects, can help explain this.
paragraphs.zh: 休闲活动常常被忽视，尽管它们在中世纪社会的大多数阶层（如果不是所有阶层的话）都以这样或那样的形式存在，但许多证据的无形性，加上实物保存不善，有助于解释这一点。

paragraphs.en: However, when conditions are right, archaeological remains can shed light on the extra-curricular activities of medieval folk. My colleagues and I found abundant evidence of life’s luxuries at the site of Caherconnell Cashel in the Burren region of western Ireland.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，在条件合适的情况下，考古遗迹可以揭示中世纪民间的课外活动。我和同事在爱尔兰西部布尔伦地区的卡赫康奈尔卡谢尔遗址发现了生活奢侈的大量证据。

paragraphs.en: Caherconnell Cashel was a farmstead of houses and workshops enclosed within a well-preserved circular dry stone wall. Such settlements are also known as ringforts and generally housed a single family (possibly multiple generations). Caherconnell was a large ringfort; the home of wealthy local rulers from the late 10th century AD to the early 17th century. Our recently concluded excavations revealed all aspects of life at this well-preserved family settlement.
paragraphs.zh: 卡赫康奈尔卡谢尔是一个农场，由房屋和作坊组成，被一堵保存完好的圆形干石墙围起来。这样的定居点也被称为环形定居点，通常住着一个家庭（可能是几代人）。卡赫康奈尔是一个大环堡;从公元世纪末到世纪初，这里是富有的地方统治者的家园。我们最近结束的发掘揭示了这口井生活的各个方面-保留家庭定居点。

paragraphs.en: While activities such as fighting, farming, industry and crafts were clearly represented in material recovered from the site, so too were the less mundane activities of game playing, literacy, and music.
paragraphs.zh: 虽然战斗、农业、工业和手工艺等活动在从遗址中恢复的材料中得到了明确的体现，但玩游戏、识字和音乐等不那么平凡的活动也是如此。

paragraphs.en: Games, pens and harps
paragraphs.zh: 游戏、笔和竖琴

paragraphs.en:
The true extent of game playing is undoubtedly lost in the perishable nature of the
materials used extensively in such pursuits – such as wood, leather and textiles. At Caherconnell, however, surviving evidence includes small gaming pieces made of
bone and antler, metal, clay and stone.
paragraphs.zh:
游戏的真正程度无疑是迷失在易腐的性质，
在Caherconnell，幸存的证据包括由木材、皮革和纺织品制成的小游戏棋子，
骨头和鹿角，金属，粘土和石头。

paragraphs.en: One of the more complete finds was an 11th-century barrel-shaped and polished antler gaming piece. A bronze peg or stem runs through its hollow core and projects from its base. It originally had a plate or cap at the top, the loss of which may have resulted in the piece being discarded or set aside for repair.
paragraphs.zh: 其中一个较为完整的发现是一个11世纪的桶形抛光鹿角游戏件。一个青铜钉或茎贯穿其中空的核心，并从其底部伸出。它最初在顶部有一个盘子或帽，丢失可能导致该件被丢弃或搁置修理。

paragraphs.en: Pegged game pieces like this were used in the Saxon and Viking board game of hnefatafl, a game that appeared in Ireland around the 9th or 10th century AD. Hnefatafl, and other games like it, provided both strategy training and entertainment.
paragraphs.zh: 撒克逊人和维京海盗人的棋类游戏《Hnefatafl》中就使用了这样的棋子。《Hnefatafl》和其他类似的游戏在世纪左右出现在爱尔兰。

paragraphs.en:
Evidence of literacy at Caherconnell includes writing implements and associated
equipment. One of our most remarkable finds was an 11th-century pen made from
bone and bronze. The slender hollow bone shaft or barrel was probably made from the bone of a wader bird or swan.
paragraphs.zh:
在Caherconnell识字的证据包括书写工具和相关的
我们最引人注目的发现之一是一支11世纪的钢笔，
骨头和青铜。细长的空心骨轴或桶可能是由涉禽或天鹅的骨头制成的。

paragraphs.en: Experimental work by the archaeologist Adam Parsons found that the closest match was a swan radius (a tubular bone) from the right-side wing. Inserted into the narrow end of the barrel is a tapering bronze point or nib.
paragraphs.zh: 考古学家亚当·帕森斯（Adam Parsons）的实验工作发现，最接近的匹配是右侧翅膀的天鹅半径（一根管状骨头），在枪管的窄端插入一个逐渐变细的青铜尖或笔尖。

paragraphs.en: The Caherconnell pen finds no exact comparisons within Ireland or elsewhere; its early secular context is also, so far, unique. Until now, evidence of early literacy in Ireland has been largely confined to monastic and related church sites. At Caherconnell, the pen may have been used in general record keeping and external communications.
paragraphs.zh: 在爱尔兰和其他地方，卡赫康奈尔笔都找不到确切的比较;到目前为止，它的早期世俗环境也是独一无二的。到目前为止，爱尔兰早期识字的证据主要局限于修道院和相关的教堂遗址。在卡赫康奈尔，笔可能被用于一般的记录保存和对外交流。

paragraphs.en: However, it also reminds us that literate occupants of Caherconnell Cashel may have enjoyed composing, reading, and sharing ancestral pedigrees, praise poetry and epic tales “of gods and fighting men”.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，它也提醒我们，有文化的居住者卡赫康奈尔卡谢尔可能喜欢作曲，阅读，并分享祖先的血统，赞美诗歌和史诗故事“的神和战士”。

paragraphs.en:
The musical sounds of a settlement are rarely represented in its archaeological
record. Wood, a common material in the construction of various instruments, rarely
survives to the present day.
paragraphs.zh:
在考古学上，
记录。木材，一种常见的材料，在建设各种文书，很少
一直延续到今天。

paragraphs.en: Metal and bone fittings, however, have been found during excavations, including at Caherconnell, where bone and bronze tuning pegs were among the finds. Two of the tuning pegs are readily identifiable as components of stringed instruments.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，在发掘过程中也发现了金属和骨头配件，包括在卡赫康奈尔发现的骨头和青铜调音钉。其中两个调音钉很容易被识别为弦乐器的组件。

paragraphs.en: They have a circular sectioned shaft that splays slightly into a rectangular sectioned turning block at one end (now missing from the larger bone example). The opposite end pinches in slightly and is perforated by a small circular hole through which the string was attached.
paragraphs.zh: 它们有一个圆形截面的轴，一端稍微张开成一个矩形截面的旋转块（现在在较大的骨头例子中缺失了），另一端稍微收缩，并穿有一个小圆孔，通过这个圆孔连接绳子。

paragraphs.en: The bone tuning peg, being a relatively soft material, still bears impressions from the wire-string of the instrument. Both date to the 11th century, but they are clearly from different instruments.
paragraphs.zh: 骨制调音钉是一种相对较软的材料，仍然带有乐器的金属弦的痕迹。两者都可以追溯到世纪，但它们显然来自不同的乐器。

paragraphs.en: One had strong bronze pegs, the other had larger bone versions. Outside Ireland, shorter tuning pegs are commonly associated with lyres, lutes and fiddles (up to 65mm is classed as short).
paragraphs.zh: 在爱尔兰以外的地方，较短的调音钉通常与七弦琴、鲁特琴和小提琴联系在一起（65毫米以下被归类为短调音钉）。

paragraphs.en:
No lutes or fiddles survive from early Ireland, however. Nor are there any
written references to, or depictions of them. The lyre, on the other hand, is
represented. Depictions are found in several ecclesiastical contexts and early Irish literature confirms that lyres or lyre-like instruments were also used outside religious settings.
paragraphs.zh:
然而，早期爱尔兰没有鲁特琴或小提琴流传下来，也没有
而另一方面，他又是另一个女人，又是另一个男人。
描绘被发现在几个教会的上下文中和早期的爱尔兰文学证实，七弦琴或类似七弦琴的文书也被用于宗教以外的设置。

paragraphs.en: Music, and accompanying songs and poetry, probably fulfilled various social, political, and cultural functions. These range from proclaiming the magnificence of the nobility to entertaining a family around their hearth in the evening.
paragraphs.zh: 音乐以及伴随的歌曲和诗歌可能实现了各种社会、政治和文化功能，从宣扬贵族的辉煌到晚上在壁炉旁款待一家人。

paragraphs.en: Life at Caherconnell was, in many ways, very traditional. It was a place where ancestry and heritage were valued, yet it was also a place connected to the outside world. In leisure, as in so many other facets of their lives, the occupants encountered, adopted, and no doubt adapted the most desirable elements of a wider cultural realm.
paragraphs.zh: 卡赫康奈尔的生活在很多方面都非常传统。这是一个重视祖先和遗产的地方，但它也是一个与外部世界相连的地方。在休闲中，就像他们生活的许多其他方面一样，居住者遇到，采用，毫无疑问，适应了更广泛的文化领域中最令人向往的元素。

paragraphs.en: It is clear from this one site that those with more leisure time, often the wealthier in society, filled that time with various recreational pursuits. However, human nature suggests that all classes engaged in such activities, albeit often in a manner that’s less visible to archaeologists.
paragraphs.zh: 从这一遗址可以清楚地看出，那些拥有更多闲暇时间的人，通常是社会上更富有的人，在那段时间里从事各种娱乐活动。然而，人类的本性表明，所有阶层都从事这样的活动，尽管通常是以考古学家不太明显的方式。

paragraphs.en: After all, you didn’t need a fancy bronze and antler game set to play games, writing equipment to create stories, or peg-tuned wired instruments to compose and sing a song. Such things just prove the existence of these activities, not how commonplace they were.
paragraphs.zh: 毕竟玩游戏不需要什么花哨的青铜鹿角游戏套装，编故事不需要什么书写设备，写歌唱歌不需要什么调音的有线乐器，这些东西只是证明了这些活动的存在，而不是它们有多普遍。
